scenes.title: Время перемен  (Time for Changes)
scenes.summary: Getting ready for his shift in the locker room, Max reflects on the inevitability of change, telling Kostya that he is determined to actively pursue the changes he wants in his life.

scenes.title: Фальшивая боль  (Fake Pain)
scenes.summary: In the restaurant corridor, Max suddenly grabs his right side and groans in pain. When a concerned Victoria rushes over to help him, he miraculously recovers and reveals his true intentions.

scenes.title: Пустое место  (An Empty Place)
scenes.summary: Undeterred by her initial rejection, Max follows Victoria to her office to apologize for his prank. However, Victoria is in no mood for jokes and delivers a crushing blow to his ego.

scenes.title: Приступ аппендицита  (An Appendicitis Attack)
scenes.summary: Max fakes a sudden appendicitis attack to get Sasha's sympathy, then surprises her with cinema tickets and asks her out on a date.

scenes.title: Опасные конкуренты  (Dangerous Competitors)
scenes.summary: Victoria shows Chef Barinov an advertising flyer for a new Italian restaurant opening next door, urging him to refresh the menu, which Barinov fiercely resists.

scenes.title: Визит к конкурентам  (A Visit to Competitors)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov crosses the street to inspect the rival restaurant Arcobaleno, exchanging witty barbs with rival chef Elena as palm trees are delivered.

scenes.title: На кухне шефа  (In the Chef's Kitchen)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov furiously scolds Senya and Fedya over messy workstations and kitchen delays, demanding complete discipline from his brigade.

scenes.title: Открытая кухня  (The Open Kitchen)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov discovers a newly installed glass wall turning his kitchen into a show kitchen, angrily questioning why Victoria ordered it.

scenes.title: Открытая кухня  (The Open Kitchen)
scenes.summary: Chef Viktor Barinov furiously confronts Victoria Sergeyevna after discovering the kitchen wall has been replaced with open glass. Victoria calmly defends the show-kitchen concept and scolds Viktor for creating a dramatic scene in front of the dining room guests.

scenes.title: Кальян и традиции  (Hookah and Traditions)
scenes.summary: Chef Viktor Barinov is disgusted to discover a hookah in the dining room of his traditional French restaurant and clashes fiercely with Victoria over modern trends. While Victoria argues that life is changing, Barinov threatens to call restaurant owner Dmitry Nagiyev.

scenes.title: Запрет на отношения  (Ban on Relationships)
scenes.summary: In the dining room of Claude Monet, Victoria reprimands Max for lingering by the bar before gathering the waitstaff. Facing the team sternly, she introduces an immediate ban on personal workplace relationships, warning that anyone who violates the policy will be fired.

scenes.title: Ссора понарошку  (Pretend Quarrel)
scenes.summary: Disturbed by Victoria's announcement, Nastya tells Kostya she is convinced the workplace ban is directed specifically at them. To keep their relationship hidden, Nastya persuades a reluctant Kostya that they must stage a fake argument in front of Victoria.

scenes.title: Запрет на романы  (The Ban on Romance)
scenes.summary: In the corridor of Claude Monet, Max confronts Victoria Sergeyevna about her newly announced strict rule prohibiting romantic relationships at work. He playfully teases her about whether she would be forced to fire herself if she ever fell in love.

scenes.title: Спектакль у бара  (Show at the Bar)
scenes.summary: To hide their romantic relationship from Victoria's strict workplace ban, Kostya and Nastya stage a fake argument at the bar counter. However, Kostya goes too far with his harsh improvised insults, leaving Nastya genuinely offended and refusing to speak to him.

scenes.title: Новое меню  (The New Menu)
scenes.summary: Chef Viktor Barinov proudly invites Victoria to the kitchen to present his supposedly innovative new menu. Victoria immediately notices that he merely gave fancy French names to his standard recipes, reminding him that real changes at Claude Monet cannot be avoided forever.

scenes.title: Ресторан напротив  (The Restaurant Across the Street)
scenes.summary: Victoria and Chef Viktor discover promotional flyers for a luxury rival restaurant opening across the street, sparking Barinov's furious competitive pride.

scenes.title: Примирение у бара  (Reconciliation by the Bar)
scenes.summary: At the bar, Kostya apologizes sincerely to Nastya for their recent fight, and the affectionate young couple happily agrees to make peace.

scenes.title: Полный зал  (A Packed House)
scenes.summary: In the Claude Monet dining room, owner Dmitry Nagiyev inspects the reservation book with hostess Angelina, celebrating that every single table is booked for the evening.

scenes.title: Отчёт разведчика  (The Scout's Report)
scenes.summary: In the back room, cook Fedya returns from scouting the rival restaurant and reports to Chef Viktor that the competitor is empty, confirming that Claude Monet needs no changes.

scenes.title: Ревность Вики  (Vika's Jealousy)
scenes.summary: In the corridor, Max tries to convince Victoria that Sasha is innocent, admitting he was just acting to make her jealous. Victoria angrily refuses to listen.

scenes.title: Пожар напротив  (Fire Across the Street)
scenes.summary: As the kitchen staff are taking a break, they suddenly notice that the new competing restaurant across the street is on fire.

scenes.title: Все в безопасности  (Everyone Is Safe)
scenes.summary: After Kostya bravely helps evacuate people from the smoke-filled neighboring restaurant, Nastya praises him with pride, and displaced patrons eagerly head over to dine at Claude Monet.

scenes.title: Перемены к лучшему  (Changes for the Better)
scenes.summary: At the bustling bar of Claude Monet, Max and Kostya watch the full dining room as Max reflects that whatever unexpected turns life takes, all changes ultimately lead to something better.
